questions.question: Since 2020, the Dakar Rally, which includes bike and quad classes, has been held in which country?
questions.fact: Since 2020, the Dakar Rally has been held in Saudi Arabia.

questions.question: The motorcycle manufacturer Ducati originates from which country?
questions.fact: Ducati is an Italian motorcycle manufacturer based in Bologna, Italy.

questions.question: In which US city was the motorcycle company Harley-Davidson founded in 1903?
questions.fact: Harley-Davidson was founded in 1903 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

questions.question: The off-road motorcycle and quad maker KTM is headquartered in which country?
questions.fact: KTM is an Austrian manufacturer headquartered in Mattighofen, Austria.

questions.question: Which Japanese company introduced the US90, a three-wheeled all-terrain vehicle, in 1970?
questions.fact: Honda introduced the US90 (later called the ATC90) three-wheeled all-terrain vehicle in 1970.

questions.question: Which manufacturer launched the QuadRunner LT125 in 1982, widely recognised as the first mass-produced four-wheeled ATV?
questions.fact: Suzuki introduced the LT125 QuadRunner in 1982, regarded as the first mass-produced four-wheeled ATV.

questions.question: In the off-road vehicle world, what does the abbreviation ATV stand for?
questions.fact: ATV stands for all-terrain vehicle.

questions.question: The first Paris–Dakar Rally, held in 1978–79, finished in the capital of which African country?
questions.fact: The Dakar Rally began as a rally from Paris, France, to Dakar, the capital of Senegal.

questions.question: Can-Am quads and side-by-sides are made by Bombardier Recreational Products, a company from which country?
questions.fact: Can-Am is a brand of Bombardier Recreational Products (BRP), a company headquartered in Valcourt, Quebec, Canada.

questions.question: In which year did a consent decree in the United States end the sale of new three-wheeled ATVs by major manufacturers?
questions.fact: In 1988 the US Consumer Product Safety Commission and ATV manufacturers agreed a consent decree that ended the sale of new three-wheeled ATVs in the United States.

questions.question: Built in 1885 by Gottlieb Daimler and Wilhelm Maybach, which vehicle is widely regarded as the first motorcycle powered by an internal combustion engine?
questions.fact: The Daimler Reitwagen, built in 1885 by Gottlieb Daimler and Wilhelm Maybach, is widely regarded as the first internal combustion motorcycle.

questions.question: Kawasaki, the maker of the Ninja motorcycles and Brute Force ATVs, comes from which country?
questions.fact: Kawasaki is a Japanese manufacturer of motorcycles and ATVs.

questions.question: The ATV and off-road vehicle maker Polaris is headquartered in which US state?
questions.fact: Polaris Inc. is headquartered in Medina, Minnesota.

questions.question: The famous Vespa scooter is produced by which Italian company?
questions.fact: Vespa scooters are manufactured by the Italian company Piaggio.

questions.question: The 2008 Dakar Rally, which included motorcycle and quad classes, was cancelled because of security threats in which country?
questions.fact: Security threats in Mauritania led to the cancellation of the 2008 Dakar Rally.

questions.question: Which Frenchman founded the Paris–Dakar Rally after getting lost in the Libyan desert during a motorcycle rally?
questions.fact: Thierry Sabine created the Paris–Dakar Rally, first held in 1978–79, after getting lost in the Libyan desert in 1977.

questions.question: BMW Motorrad motorcycles, such as the R 1250 GS adventure bike, come from which country?
questions.fact: BMW Motorrad is the motorcycle brand of the German company BMW, which is headquartered in Munich.

questions.question: The motorcycle brand Royal Enfield began in Britain, but its parent company is now headquartered in which country?
questions.fact: Royal Enfield is owned by the Indian company Eicher Motors and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

questions.question: Which Japanese motorcycle and ATV maker uses a logo of three crossed tuning forks, reflecting its origins in musical instruments?
questions.fact: Yamaha's logo shows three crossed tuning forks because the company began as a maker of musical instruments.

questions.question: Honda's three-wheeled off-road vehicles of the 1970s and 1980s were sold under the trademark "ATC". What did ATC stand for?
questions.fact: Honda marketed its three-wheeled off-road vehicles as ATCs, short for All-Terrain Cycle.

questions.question: In 1935, T. E. Lawrence, known as "Lawrence of Arabia", died after crashing a motorcycle made by which British manufacturer?
questions.fact: T. E. Lawrence was fatally injured in 1935 while riding his Brough Superior SS100 motorcycle in Dorset, England.

questions.question: What does the rider of a standard quad bike (ATV) use to steer it?
questions.fact: By the ANSI definition, an ATV has a seat the operator straddles and handlebars for steering, similar to a motorcycle.

questions.question: Off-road vehicles that are similar to ATVs but seat several people next to each other are commonly known by which abbreviation?
questions.fact: Multi-user off-road vehicles with side-by-side seating are called utility terrain vehicles (UTVs), or side-by-sides.

questions.question: The Husqvarna brand, which has made motorcycles since 1903, originated in which country?
questions.fact: Husqvarna began producing motorcycles in Sweden in 1903.

questions.question: In 2012, the Italian motorcycle maker Ducati was acquired by which carmaker, through its Lamborghini subsidiary?
questions.fact: In 2012, Audi acquired Ducati through its subsidiary Lamborghini.

questions.question: The Yamaha Banshee sport quad, launched in 1987, used a two-stroke twin-cylinder engine derived from which Yamaha motorcycle?
questions.fact: The Yamaha Banshee 350 ATV was powered by a 347 cc two-stroke parallel-twin engine derived from the Yamaha RZ350 motorcycle.

questions.question: Triumph, the motorcycle brand behind the Bonneville and the Speed Triple, comes from which country?
questions.fact: Triumph Motorcycles is a British manufacturer based in Hinckley, England.

questions.question: From 2009 to 2019, the Dakar Rally, including its bike and quad classes, was held on which continent?
questions.fact: After the 2008 cancellation, the Dakar Rally was held in South America from 2009 to 2019.

questions.question: Which two-stroke Suzuki sport quad, introduced in 1987, earned the nickname 'Quadzilla'?
questions.fact: The Suzuki LT500R, a 500 cc two-stroke sport ATV launched in 1987, is famously nicknamed 'Quadzilla'.

questions.question: Which German motorcycle, first sold in 1894, is widely regarded as the first motorcycle to go into series production?
questions.fact: The Hildebrand & Wolfmüller of 1894 is widely regarded as the first series-production motorcycle.
